name: How long does the design phase for a detached ADU typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the design phase for a detached ADU typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The design phase for a detached ADU typically takes between 1 to 3 months. This period includes initial consultations, site analysis, conceptual design, architectural drawings, and revisions based on your feedback. Factors influencing this timeline include the complexity of the design, the number of revisions requested, and the speed of client communication. An efficient design phase sets the foundation for a smooth permitting and construction process.
acceptedAnswer.description: The design phase for a detached ADU usually takes 1-3 months, involving consultations, conceptual design, drawings, and client revisions.
